preconditions.description: The graph has between 1 and 100,000 nodes and edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects nodes within the valid range [1, n].
The input contains exactly m edges.
The graph is connected (no need to explicitly check; guaranteed by problem statement).

postconditions.description: The output sequence contains exactly n nodes.
The output sequence contains all nodes from 1 to n exactly once.
The output sequence is lexicographically smallest among all possible valid sequences.
